purpose: Turn the completed Campo Grafico 1933-1939 evidence corpus into a measurable image-prompt generation experiment while keeping research evidence separate from runtime experience.
principle: Research feeds execution; execution feeds experience memory; experience must never rewrite historical evidence.

inputs.forbidden_shortcut: Do not name Campo Grafico, Italian style, vintage magazine, or any source publication in the experimental prompt.

compiler_output_contract.semantic_intent: What the image must mean before visual styling.
compiler_output_contract.selected_grammars: Only evidence-backed grammars necessary for this task.
compiler_output_contract.composition_directives: Spatial hierarchy, scale, density, asymmetrical equilibrium, image/text relation, material behavior.
compiler_output_contract.material_directives: Physical/print/object qualities only when semantically justified.
compiler_output_contract.negative_constraints: Prevent motif copying, nostalgia, decorative collage, generic luxury-editorial styling and unjustified distressing.
compiler_output_contract.image_prompt: Compact executor-ready prompt with no publication/style-name shortcut.
compiler_output_contract.provenance: Grammar IDs and evidence packets used to compile the prompt.

control.prompt: Create a beautiful high-end modern Italian editorial magazine image for the supplied content.
control.rule: Control receives the same semantic content and image-generation executor but no Campo Grafico evidence retrieval.

blind_acceptance: Experimental output is judged more beautiful and editorially intentional than control without relying on source-name recognition.
Composition expresses the supplied content rather than merely exhibiting period motifs.
At least one selected grammar has a traceable evidence path to the canonical corpus.
No copied masthead, logo, recognizable historical page, or publication-specific motif is required for success.
Aesthetic Judge can reject a technically successful but editorially empty candidate.
A semantically different second task can reuse the learned intelligence without reproducing the first composition.
A non-applicable task can decline the Campo Grafico grammar instead of forcing it.

experience_memory_contract.must_not: Promote runtime preference, accidental model behavior, or a successful visual motif into historical evidence.

capability_gate: No Capability Registry or System Atlas promotion from this experiment alone. Require successful same-source differentiation, unseen-task transfer, negative selection, provenance backtrace and later blind reuse.
